name: @foreverworks/mcp-rag
description: MCP server for retrieval over your own documents: index PDFs (with OCR), images, docx and Markdown into Postgres with pgvector, then search them with hybrid retrieval and a reranker, on your machine or with indexing at Cloudflare Workers AI

mcp.title: Local RAG
mcp.tagline: Index your PDFs, scans and documents locally, and search them with hybrid retrieval and a reranker.

RAG_DATABASE_URL.title: Database URL
RAG_DATABASE_URL.description: postgresql:// URL of a database with the vector extension; the password may be left out of it.

RAG_DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE.title: Database password file
RAG_DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE.description: Path of a file holding the database password, when the URL does not carry it.

RAG_EMBED_URL.title: Embedding server
RAG_EMBED_URL.description: Base URL of a text-embeddings-inference server running an embedding model.

RAG_RERANK_URL.title: Rerank server
RAG_RERANK_URL.description: Base URL of a text-embeddings-inference server running a reranker model.

RAG_SOURCE_ROOTS.title: Folders to index
RAG_SOURCE_ROOTS.description: Folders the server may read documents from, separated by colons.

RAG_OCR_LANGUAGE.title: OCR language
RAG_OCR_LANGUAGE.description: Tesseract language code for scanned pages, such as eng or ron (default eng).

RAG_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.title: Cloudflare account
RAG_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: The Cloudflare account that runs Workers AI, for collections indexed there.

RAG_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN_FILE.title: Cloudflare API token file
RAG_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN_FILE.description: Path of a file holding a Cloudflare API token allowed to run Workers AI on that account.

author: Forever Works
